claims.text: architect-week.md logs one assumed week of the architect role; the role works with all three teams of ADR 0025 (Ordering, Shop, platform) and belongs to none (assumed); the doc does not decide who holds it, names nobody, and says nothing of titles or pay.
The week is set after ADR 0025 is accepted: the platform and Ordering teams work per team-structure.md and the Shop team is newly formed.

The calendar holds: pre-reading and attending the support chat design review, comments on a proposed ADR, two pull request reviews, reading postmortem 0001, a roadmap meeting with the product owner, a 1-1, pairing on a check, a leadership brief update, answering teams' requests.

Assumed hours of 40, not industry figures: reviews/documents 16-20 (pre-reading, ADR comments, PR reviews, postmortem, brief edits), conversations 10-14 (review session, roadmap, leadership, team requests), mentoring 3-5 (1-1, review comments with reasons), code 3-5.

The code share is small but not zero: it keeps the role aware of how much effort a decision costs the team that follows it, and it is for checking a decision (such as a check), not for features. Opinion: writing Thursday's check is the kind of change a team makes to follow a rule.

Each activity ends in something recorded (a pull request comment, an open question row with someone to answer it, a roadmap note); a decision only spoken in a meeting cannot be found by those who come later, who must ask again.

The audience changes by day: developers get the reason behind a rule, the product owner (who decides what the team builds next, so the roadmap's order) trade-offs as results a shop sees, leadership the decision needed from them first, then the reasons.
No ADR listed in docs/adr/README.md at stage-4 has status Đề xuất; the Monday ADR (a cap on chat connections per shop, first risk of support-chat-design-review.md) is assumed.

claims.text: Thursday pairing (assumed): a check that the api refuses to start when RateLimiting:CatalogReads is below a minimum, an action item of postmortem 0001; output a small PR with a test; once merged it becomes a row of 'Phép kiểm đang có' in fitness-functions.md.
Wednesday: postmortem 0001's action item to choose a component that sends notifications for alerts has no item in roadmap.md; the output is a note for the roadmap meeting.

Friday: the role presents the platform team brief update to leadership and the team lead, the decision asked for first (assumed: a fourth person for the platform team); the answer is recorded in the brief.
Each activity already has its own method in the repository; the doc only shows how they fit in a week; the last calendar column names the file holding each method.

Outputs: replica PR → comments, 'don't know' as an open question in the PR (cluster-review-checklist.md); roadmap → order kept or changed, moved items into 'Đã dời' with reason; design review → open-question row with owner by role and deadline.

A week whose largest share goes to reviews and documents fits when several teams share decisions crossing their boundaries; an architect coding features in one team fits one small team whose decisions rarely leave it (opposing view).
When a team asks the architect to build one of its features, the feature stays with the team that will own and run it; the architect offers to pair on the check guarding the rule instead.
A diagram alone records no driver, rejected option or owner; in a design review it is one section among them.
Comments on a proposed ADR go in its pull request during the comment period; comments that change the decision go into the ADR's 'Ý kiến đã nhận' section.
